title: A home page, drawn from memory of the genre
label: Brand gallery
lede: The Internet Archive was not responding when this page was researched, so there are no screenshots of the real site here, and we found no freely licensed images of it. These are our own drawings of the kind of thing the company sold. They are not official artwork.
